criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: The named Faith West Community Center matches the saved OSM way 743763888 at 1920 Northwestern Avenue. Independently projected the raw 39-vertex closed ring using the documented campus transform and compared it to ground-level vertices of the podium wall mesh: max OSM-vertex-to-model-vertex distance 0.0250 m; max model-vertex-to-OSM-segment distance 0.0251 m. Projected source polygon area 3102.36 m² agrees with the preserved footprint record.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The projected source bounds and structural podium bounds agree within 0.025 m on X and Y. Vertex order preserves the mapped orientation and irregular multi-wing footprint. The complete decorative model extends beyond the structural bounds because of porches/balconies; the OSM footprint is the reference for the podium shell.
findings: The source is volunteered OpenStreetMap geometry transformed with the project's local approximation, not a surveyed wall line.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: KJG Architecture and Titan Construction imagery support a four-story residential wing, lower community podium, dark sloped roofs, and rooftop services. The model has a podium plus three upper wall levels, three gable pieces, flat community-wing roof panels, and HVAC objects. Its 15.93 m ridge/overall height and story elevations are modeled estimates; the roof deck reads as one broad continuous plane and the source images show more articulated intersecting roof slopes.
findings: No measured elevation or as-built roof-height drawing was found.
The modeled roof silhouette is simplified compared with the multiple joined roof slopes visible in the aerial and exterior references.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The model includes the dark brick community podium, lighter upper housing levels, repeated windows and frames, selective balconies, cafe patio/umbrellas, entry and community/fitness/preschool signs. The references support these broad features. The candidate render is noticeably more uniform and less articulated than the KJG and Faith Church photos; the curved public-facing podium facade and roof-to-wall transitions are simplified, and the material mapping appears banded in places.
findings: Exterior finish and entrance geometry need refinement to match the source photos more closely.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: The exact SHA was independently verified and freshly opened in Blender 5.2.3. Expected scene and collection contain 34 named objects (31 meshes and 3 text objects), 17 materials, no empty mesh objects, no linked libraries, no unpacked external images, and no cameras/lights in the export collection. The evidence folder preserves raw OSM data, provider/source metadata, several project/reference photos, a footprint plot, and exterior/interior renders.
findings: Interior partitions and furniture are schematic and follow the published program; no source-backed floor plan is available. The saved cutaway preview is separated/exploded and does not clearly show a coherent occupied interior.
